therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: tumor cell proliferation and survival signaling
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: untreated locally advanced squamous cell carcinoma of the head and neck
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: change in tumor response and progression between pre- and post-panitumumab therapy

results.effect_size: No results reported - insufficient tissue collection
safety_signals: Biopsy procedure removed due to potential risk for participants
results.dose_information: 9mg/kg IV single dose prior to definitive therapy, with optional additional doses at weeks 1 & 4 of radiation therapy

context.investigator_commentary: Study terminated early - only 2 of 6 subjects had fresh tissue collected after first panitumumab dose, biopsy procedure removed due to potential participant risk
